import sys, importlib.util, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
mode = sys.argv[1]; idx = int(sys.argv[2])
line = open('req_culprit.jsonl').read().splitlines()[idx].strip()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner", "/app/submission/planner.py")

req = planner.validate(planner.parse_request(line))
prob = planner.build_problem(req); prob["epoch"]=req["epoch"]

        cand=planner.optimal_response(prob,planner.make_primal(prob,res),planner.dual_by_lp(prob))
